message.text: I need to examine the DeleteMemo implementation in the store layer and API handler to identify which related records are deleted before the memo row itself.
The store layer deletes memo_relation records where this memo is the source or target, plus attachments linked to this memo, before removing the memo row itself. This logic is in store/memo.go.

Tracing the deletion order in Store.DeleteMemo within store/memo.go.

The store layer deletes memo_relation records and attachments before removing the memo row itself.

q16.
memo_relation rows (where the memo is source or target), then attachments

`Store.DeleteMemo` in `store/memo.go` calls `DeleteMemoRelation` for `MemoID` and `RelatedMemoID`, then `DeleteAttachment` for each linked attachment, then `driver.DeleteMemo`. The API handler in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` deletes comment memos first; that is not store-layer cleanup of the memo row itself.
